headline: Textron (TXT) Stock Could Be 44% Cheap As Training Aircraft Orders Build
summary: Textron stock has paused after a weaker recent spell, yet the company still screens as undervalued on both its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiples. This puts the current US$85.26 share price under closer scrutiny. Textron has delivered about 18.0% total return over the past 5 years, which points to steady value creation over a full market cycle.
